crossRefs.note: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: This will be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.
translations.bsb: This will be the punishment of Egypt and of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
translations.kjv: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
translations.asv: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations that go not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
